categories.Undead, zombies and crawlers: The walking dead, from cartoon zombies to torsos that drag themselves along on their arms.
categories.Orcs, trolls and brutes: Orcs of every rank, trolls, a golem and the big hulks that hit hardest in a melee.
categories.Demons and devils: Horned fiends and devils: lean ones that slash, fat ones that crush, a few bosses.
